policies.inbound:
<set-variable name="imageRequest" value="@{
            var body = context.Request.Body?.As(preserveContent: true) ?? new JObject();
            var quality = body["quality"]?.ToString() ?? "";
            var size = body["size"]?.ToString() ?? "";
            body["quality"] = (quality == "" || quality == "auto") ? "{default-quality}" : quality.ToLowerInvariant();
            body["size"] = (size == "" || size == "auto") ? "{default-size}" : size;
            if (body["n"] == null || body["n"].Type == JTokenType.Null) { body["n"] = 1; }
            return body.ToString();
        }" />
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
        
            <when condition="@((int)context.Variables["imageUnitMicroUsd"] < 0 || (int)context.Variables["imagesRequested"] < 1 || (int)context.Variables["imagesRequested"] > {max-images-per-request})">
                
                    
                    
                        application/json
                    
                    
                        image-pricing
                    
                    
                        @(context.RequestId.ToString())
                    
                    @(new JObject(new JProperty("error", new JObject(
                        new JProperty("code", "ImageRequestNotPriced"),
                        new JProperty("message", "No price for model '" + (string)context.Variables["requestedModel"] + "', quality '" + (string)context.Variables["imageQuality"] + "', size '" + (string)context.Variables["imageSize"] + "', or n outside 1-{max-images-per-request}. Priced combinations: " + (string)context.Variables["imagePricing"])))).ToString())
                
            
        
        @((string)context.Variables["imageRequest"])

choose.when:
<set-variable name="imageCount" value="@{
                    var data = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["data"] as JArray;
                    return data == null ? 0 : data.Count;
                }" />
                
                <set-variable name="promptTokens" value="@{
                    var usage = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["usage"] as JObject;
                    return usage == null || usage["input_tokens"] == null ? 0 : (int)usage["input_tokens"];
                }" />
                <set-variable name="completionTokens" value="@{
                    var usage = context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true)["usage"] as JObject;
                    return usage == null || usage["output_tokens"] == null ? 0 : (int)usage["output_tokens"];
                }" />
                
                
                    
                    
                    
                    
                    
                
                
                    @(((int)context.Variables["imageCount"]).ToString())
                
                
                    @(((int)context.Variables["imageUnitMicroUsd"] / 1000000.0).ToString("0.000000"))
                
                
                    @((string)context.Variables["imageQuality"] + " " + (string)context.Variables["imageSize"])
                
                
                    @(((int)context.Variables["costMicroUsd"] / 1000000.0).ToString("0.000000"))
